newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS TUESDAY FIRMER ON KEY UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS TUESDAY FIRMER ON KEY UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was firmer against key currencies at the close of Tuesday interbank trade on the back of export receipts which outweighed importer demand, dealers said.
"There were some good receipts in the market today and the dollar firmed against hard currencies. But generally trading was very mild," a dealer said.
The local unit ended the day at 10.3150/3350 against the U.S. dollar, up from Monday's 10.3300/3500, while against sterling it strengthened to 16.1300/1700 from 16.1540/1930 at the previous close.
It was also firmer at 6.7630/7790 from 6.7650/7810 against the mark and at 2.2710/2770 against the rand compared with 2.2800/2860 overnight.
